examples.label: Pricing plan picker with three tiers
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Choose a plan <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">Switch or cancel whenever you like; we bill for the days you used.
<.component component_name="chelekom-radio-card" site="Global" id="pricing-plan" name="plan" cols="three" cols_gap="small" padding="medium" rounded="large"> <:radio value="starter" title="Starter" description="$0 — one site, community support">
Good for a personal blog you publish once a week.
<:radio value="team" title="Team" checked description="$29 per editor — five sites, drafts and review">
The one most agencies land on after the first month.
<:radio value="business" title="Business" description="$79 per editor — unlimited sites, audit log, SSO">
Adds the retention and access controls procurement asks about.

examples.label: Checkout shipping speed chooser
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">How soon do you need it? <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-card" site="Global" id="shipping-speed" name="shipping" cols="two" cols_gap="small" padding="small" show_radio> <:radio value="standard" checked title="Standard" description="Free — arrives Thursday 12 March"> <:radio value="express" title="Express" description="$12 — arrives tomorrow before noon">

Orders placed after 4 p.m. ship the following working day.

examples.label: Notification frequency settings row
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-card" site="Global" id="digest-frequency" name="digest" label="Email digest" description="How often we should collect activity into one message." show_radio space="small" padding="small"> <:radio value="realtime" title="As it happens" description="One email per comment, mention and review request"> <:radio value="daily" checked title="Once a day" description="A single summary sent at 8 a.m. in your timezone"> <:radio value="weekly" title="Once a week" description="Monday morning, everything from the week before"> <:radio value="never" title="Never" description="Nothing by email — check the notification centre instead">
